eligibility_scope: optional CLI comparison cell under this protocol; not a release-readiness or platform-support gate

settings.background_load: build-process preflight only; thermal conditions and other host work are not controlled
settings.coverage_limit: untimed marker/config pass preserves global filters; unavailable counters stay unverified; witnesses do not prove every byte was scanned on each timed run
settings.coverage_policy: marker identity multiset and exact path/commit unit set; marker coordinate differences remain reported separately; available counter contradictions fail coverage
settings.feature_policy: shared: explicit task depth 0/1; shipped: preserve defaults, raise only when below required depth
settings.finding_projection: nine benchmark fields, including four exact coordinates; not full report equivalence
settings.memory_scope: OS-reported wait4 exact-child maximum; not aggregate process-tree peak
settings.order: Williams ABDC/BCAD/CDBA/DACB, repeated; A/B/C/D follows tool_order
settings.output_limit_policy: poll every 10ms and after exit; limits are not filesystem quotas
settings.shared_rules_concurrency: GOMAXPROCS=1 for Go scheduler only; not equal workers, OS threads, or CPU quota
settings.shipped_rules_concurrency: shipped defaults; no concurrency environment overrides
settings.statistics: median, min, max, MAD; even-size median averages middle values; no p95 or significance claim
settings.timing_scope: full CLI startup through direct-child exit and JSON writes; no fsync durability guarantee

speedup_policy: not computed; compare only eligible complete cells with equivalent validated outcome and coverage
